remarks: Welcome to 39 Fair Street, Norwalk - a fantastic opportunity for first-time homebuyers or downsizers looking for value, convenience, and long-term upside. This well-maintained home features major mechanical updates, including natural gas heat, central air, and a newer roof, offering peace of mind for years to come.  Set on a level lot with a private driveway, the property also includes a desirable 2-car detached garage - perfect for storage, hobbies, or additional parking. Enjoy added living space with a charming enclosed front porch and a sunroom/enclosed patio at the rear - ideal for relaxing summer days, entertaining, or creating a flexible den area.  Inside, the home offers a functional layout with great natural light and solid bones, while leaving room for your personal touch and cosmetic updates to truly make it your own.  Located in a highly convenient Norwalk location, you're just minutes to shopping, dining, transportation, and major commuting routes, making this an ideal option for buyers seeking accessibility without sacrificing privacy.  Whether you're looking to downsize into something manageable or step into homeownership with upside potential, this property checks all the boxes. Don't miss the chance to customize and build equity in a strong market.
